commit_message:
[Codegen][Tuner] Materialize constraint assignments in compiler (#24470)

Add compiler bindings that materialize a concrete compilation_info attr
from an iree_codegen.smt.constraints op and a flat knob assignment
dictionary. This gives the tuner a compiler-owned path for turning
solver models back into the attrs the compiler consumes.

Keep the common helper mechanical: it only substitutes IntKnobAttr and
OneOfKnobAttr leaves, then asks the pipeline attr to repackage the
materialized knob dictionary. GPU pipelines own their lowering_config
and translation_info spelling, while unsupported pipelines use the
default interface failure instead of generic dictionary guessing.

Add lit and Python binding coverage for successful materialization and
invalid assignments.

Issue: https://github.com/iree-org/iree/issues/23535

Assisted-by: codex
